Notes_and_Tips: This plan is designed to support healthy growth while gradually improving body composition.
Choose homemade sweets only occasionally and avoid packaged sugary snacks.
When attending social gatherings, eat a planned meal beforehand to reduce overeating.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Continue practicing yoga regularly and stay active with outdoor games or walking whenever possible.
Drink at least 2–2.5 litres of water daily and maintain regular meal timings.
